questions.q: What did Dooley's acne teach her?
a: Hiding flaws makes the underlying problem worse
Makeup is the best way to build confidence
Skin problems are purely genetic
Success depends on looking perfect
questions.why: Lesson 1 says covering her acne with makeup made it worse, just as hiding flaws deepens insecurity.

Pressure from bosses to outperform colleagues
The urge to compete in organized sports

questions.q: How does Dooley suggest beating comparison?
a: Recenter on your own purpose and notice your progress
Delete all social media permanently
Avoid the gym until you feel confident
Compete harder to prove yourself
questions.why: Lesson 2 advises recentering on your purpose, such as getting fit rather than racing others.

questions.q: What does the 10-10-10 rule ask you to consider?
a: Consequences in 10 minutes, 10 weeks and 10 years
Ten goals, ten habits and ten rewards
Ten minutes of work every ten hours
Ten opinions gathered over ten days
questions.why: Lesson 3 cites Suzy Welch's 10-10-10 rule for weighing consequences over three time spans.

questions.q: What does Dooley recommend for a 30-day challenge?
a: Avoid self-criticism and speak to yourself kindly
Exercise for thirty minutes every day
Post one honest photo each day
Write down ten compliments from others
questions.why: Lesson 1 suggests a 30-day challenge of not criticizing yourself and treating yourself like a friend.
